newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cerner Corp rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cerner Corp rating cut.

text.p: -- Vector Securities International Inc said Wednesday it cut its rating on Cerner Corp to neutral from buy due to valuation.

-- "While Cerner continues to impress us as the leader in enterprise-wide clinical information solutions, we believe that with a current valuation of 54 times '97 earnings and 34 times '98 earnings, the stock is ahead of itself on fundamentals and better investment opportunities exist within the group," Vector said in a report.
